about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/syntax: edits of the parser's derived forms that the package's tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/syntax; a unit that cannot afford the coverage pass applies each edit by hand and runs the killer. Seeded by wf10 batch-15 fix-r2 (L11b M1).

mutants.name: pure-clause-not-parsed
mutants.rule: grammar.md Declarations 15: pure between a parameter's name and its type is the clause.

mutants.name: pure-clause-not-printed
mutants.rule: The formatter keeps a parameter's pure clause, so formatting keeps the tree.

mutants.name: builtin-target-any-name
mutants.rule: An extern target with no import path names a Go builtin.

mutants.name: l11b-s1
mutants.to:
d := types[name]
	if true || d == nil ||
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: the round-trip law of an open X draws x itself.

mutants.name: l11b-inline-variant-closed
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: a union of inline records of exported fields is open, so its law draws x.

mutants.name: l11b-unexported-field-open
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: a record with an unexported field is built only by its package; its law draws b through ParseX.

mutants.name: rc4b-format-drops-derive
mutants.rule: ergo fmt prints a derive as written (patterns.md, Derivation; the decided fixture derive.ergo formats to itself).

mutants.name: try1-groups-right
mutants.rule: grammar.md Expressions 1 (q105): a try in operand position wraps its operand only; it adds no grouping.

mutants.name: exm1-own-name-read-as-mode
mutants.from: e.own = nil // a parameter named own
mutants.rule: own is contextual: in a named list, own T is a parameter named own (q168).

mutants.name: exm1-writes-takes-fn
mutants.rule: own on a function-typed parameter takes nothing, so a literal that writes only it still takes its expected type's clause (q168).
